summary: Phase 0/1/2 backend tested via pytest (44/44 passed on /api/*): auth (login/signup/logout/me/wrong-password), tenant isolation (new signup cannot read demo contacts), role enforcement (staff 403 on dashboard/settings/templates/services/invite/process/admin/*; owner 403 on /admin/*), CRM (quick-add + duplicate 409, search, CSV import 10 rows + re-import all duplicates), appointments (conflict 409, past rejected), templates/settings (invalid review link + bad quiet hours rejected), invite URL issued, public garage/business/slots/book (consent-optional) + honeypot, admin overview/tenants/numbers/audits + masked secrets, cron auth (401 w/o bearer, 200 + duplicate=true on same X-Webhook-Id), Twilio webhook signature rejects (403), manual send blocked for no-consent contact. Frontend login flow is BROKEN end-to-end for any real browser due to origin-guard middleware vs. ingress-rewritten Origin header (see RCA). All assertions on data (not only status codes); test file uses pytest fixtures and TEST_ prefix.

critical.issue: Browser requests from https://garage-sms-crm.preview.emergentagent.com are rejected with 403 'Request origin not allowed.' The Kubernetes/Cloudflare ingress REWRITES the Origin header to the internal cluster hostname 'https://garage-sms-crm.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud' before it reaches FastAPI, but origin_guard compares it against PUBLIC_BASE_URL only. Result: NO USER CAN LOG IN, SIGN UP, BOOK, OR DO ANY WRITE OPERATION FROM A BROWSER. GETs still work (no origin check), so the UI renders /login but every form submit silently 403s (visible toast 'Request origin not allowed.' seen in Playwright screenshots). Verified by temporary logging: origin='https://garage-sms-crm.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud' expected='https://garage-sms-crm.preview.emergentagent.com'.

ui_bugs.issue: After filling owner credentials and clicking Sign in, user stays on /login with a red 'Request origin not allowed.' toast (root cause is backend origin_guard, see critical issue). Blocks ALL authenticated UI testing.

Services render but could not locate data-testid='public-consent' on initial load (step 1 only shows service list; consent appears later in flow). Could not exercise full flow because UI is partially JS-rendered and public-book-submit testid not visible until later steps; the backend /api/public/book endpoint itself works (verified via pytest).

integration_issues.flow: Entire authenticated UI (login, dashboard, calendar, customers, inbox, automations, settings, admin, impersonation)
integration_issues.issue: Cannot test ANY of these from the browser because every POST /api/auth/login returns 403 due to origin header mismatch. Backend endpoints themselves are healthy (pytest 44/44).

action_items: FIX ORIGIN GUARD (server.py line 26-29): the ingress rewrites Origin to the internal cluster hostname. Options: (a) also honour CORS_ORIGINS env list (currently '*') and skip the check when CORS_ORIGINS='*'; (b) include the known preview-cluster origin ('https://garage-sms-crm.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud') or wildcard '*.preview.emergentcf.cloud' and '*.preview.emergentagent.com' via regex; (c) extract host from Origin and compare host only, since https scheme is enforced by edge; (d) simply remove the duplicate CSRF-origin middleware and rely on SameSite=None cookies + CORS (recommended – browsers already reject cross-site writes via CORS pre-flight when credentials=true and allow_origins is explicit). Current behaviour makes the preview app unusable from any browser.

After fix: retest login + full UI flows (dashboard, calendar booking, customer quick-add, CSV import, inbox simulate-reply YES/STOP/CANCEL, settings save + invite accept in fresh browser, admin approve/suspend/activate + impersonation banner, public booking end-to-end on mobile 390px, review redirect /api/r/{token}).

rca of the issue: RCA (origin_guard blocks all browser POSTs on preview URL): The FastAPI app installs a custom middleware `origin_guard` (server.py lines 24-30) that rejects any mutating request whose Origin header does not match origin() (= PUBLIC_BASE_URL env, 'https://garage-sms-crm.preview.emergentagent.com') or 'http://localhost:3000'. However the k8s/Cloudflare preview ingress REWRITES Origin to the internal routable hostname 'https://garage-sms-crm.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud' before the request reaches the pod. Confirmation: enabled temporary logging and observed `origin='https://garage-sms-crm.cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud' expected='https://garage-sms-crm.preview.emergentagent.com'`. Reproduction: `curl -X POST https://garage-sms-crm.preview.emergentagent.com/api/auth/login -H 'Origin: https://garage-sms-crm.preview.emergentagent.com' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"owner@demo.revloop.test","password":"RevLoop-Demo-2026!"}'` -> HTTP 403 {"detail":"Request origin not allowed."}. Without Origin header: 200 (that is why pytest passed). Mitigation (ordered by safety): 1) Trust CORS middleware alone — delete `origin_guard` entirely (SameSite=None+Secure cookies + explicit CORS allow_origins list already protects against CSRF/cross-site writes). 2) If keeping it, replace equality check with a regex that whitelists '*.preview.emergentagent.com' and '*.preview.emergentcf.cloud' as well as any additional origins listed in CORS_ORIGINS. 3) Also fix CORS: CORS_ORIGINS='*' + allow_credentials=True is non-compliant – browsers ignore '*' with credentials; set explicit list including the two preview hosts.
